name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavorText: Using telepathy only fellow Exeggcute can pick up on, they always form a cluster of six.

name: Alolan Exeggutor

abilities.name: Scale Up
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has 6 or more Grass Energy attached, it gets +250 HP.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 50 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

name: Volbeat

attacks.name: Luring Glow
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

flavorText: It flashes the light on its rear to communicate with other Volbeat. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

name: Illumise

abilities.name: Supereffective Pheromones
abilities.text: If you have Volbeat in play, apply Weakness for both Active Pokémon as ×3.

flavorText: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.

name: Tropius

attacks.name: Rally Back
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavorText: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

name: Cherubi

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavorText: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.

name: Cherrim

attacks.name: Energy Gift
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It's full of energy while it's like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

name: Vivillon

abilities.name: Guiding Dance
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Poison Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavorText: This Pokémon was born in a special land. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Wild Kick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

name: Moltres

abilities.name: Fiery Flapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have Articuno and Zapdos in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

name: Ho-Oh

attacks.name: Sacred Breath
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. Heal all damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

name: Victini

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Reshiram

attacks.name: Laser Flame
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Lightning Energy attached, this attack does 80 more damage.

flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

name: Fuecoco ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Cheerful Flame
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each Prize card you have taken.

name: Slowpoke

attacks.name: Well-Hidden
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

name: Lapras

attacks.name: Ferry Across
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

name: Articuno

abilities.name: Frosty Flapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have Moltres and Zapdos in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Water Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hail
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Kyogre

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

flavorText: In myths, this Pokémon expanded the seas with torrential rains and great tsunamis. It battled ferociously against Groudon.

name: Palkia

attacks.name: Wormhole
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

flavorText: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

name: Greninja ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Stealthy Slash
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each damage counter on that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Wishiwashi

abilities.name: Counterattack Grouping
abilities.text: If your Wishiwashi or Wishiwashi ex is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if your Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. When in a tough spot, this Pokémon discharges electricity.

attacks.name: Pika-Pika Parade
attacks.text: Search your deck for any number of Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Pikachu ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Zip-Zap Frenzy
attacks.text: You may attach any number of Basic Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

name: Zapdos

abilities.name: Flash-Pop Flapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have Moltres and Articuno in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thundering Lightning
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.

flavorText: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

name: Zekrom

attacks.name: Nitro Thunder
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Fire Energy attached, this attack does 80 more damage.

flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

name: Zeraora

attacks.name: Rapid Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Electrobullet
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

name: Toxel
flavorText: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

name: Toxtricity
flavorText: As it gulps down stagnant water and generates electricity in its body, a sound like a rhythm played by a bass guitar reverberates all around.

name: Toxtricity

attacks.name: Thunderous Bolt
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

flavorText: The jolts of electricity it launches by violently strumming the protrusions on its chest easily exceed 15,000 volts.

name: Morpeko

attacks.name: Select a Snack
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand.

flavorText: It has a small stomach. If it isn't constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.

name: Miraidon

attacks.name: Electro Drift
attacks.text: Discard 2 Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Empower
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psydrive
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Created from the DNA of Mew, this Pokémon is a dangerous combination of overwhelming power and a savage heart.

name: Mewtwo ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Photon Bullets
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon ex. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Psychic Powers
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

name: Mew

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

name: Mew ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Memory Helix
abilities.text: This Pokémon can use the attacks of any of your Benched Pokémon. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

attacks.name: Teleportation Burst
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Marill
flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it's fine even in rivers with strong currents.

name: Azumarill

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

name: Espeon

attacks.name: Miraculous Shine
attacks.text: Devolve each of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

flavorText: It uses the fine fur on its body to sense movement in the air and predict the weather...as well as its foes' thoughts.

name: Espeon ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Solar Beatdown
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Pokémon in play.

name: Sylveon ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Colorful Harmony
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each type of Basic Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

name: Unown

attacks.name: Mysterious Signal
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 1 more Prize card.

flavorText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Drifloon

attacks.name: Float Up
attacks.text: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

flavorText: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “signpost for wandering spirits.”

name: Cresselia

attacks.name: Aurora Gain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Chandelure

attacks.name: Eerie Glow
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.

flavorText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Xerneas

attacks.name: Geonavigation
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Stadium cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Comfey

attacks.name: Comforting Aroma
attacks.text: Heal 80 damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: It prefers areas with lots of flowers. A Comfey adorned with flowers is a happy Comfey, and the flowers gain healing effects.

name: Cosmog
flavorText: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.

name: Cosmoem

attacks.name: Stiffen
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 60 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon's growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.

name: Lunala

attacks.name: Midnight Ray
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy card in your discard pile.

flavorText: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.

name: Gimmighoul

attacks.name: Strolls So Much
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: It wanders around, carrying an old coin on its back. It survives by draining the life-force from humans who try to pick up its coin.

name: Groudon

attacks.name: Break Ground
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: Groudon is said to have expanded the reach of dry land by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled ferociously against Kyogre.

name: Lucario

attacks.name: Aura Sphere
attacks.text: This attack also does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

name: Seismitoad

attacks.name: Quaking Fist
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever they try to use a Trainer card from their hand, they flip a coin. If tails, your opponent discards that Trainer card instead of using it.

flavorText: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

name: Lycanroc

attacks.name: Counter
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does that much more damage.

flavorText: This Lycanroc has an extremely vicious temperament. It will happily sustain injuries for the sake of taking down its opponent.

name: Koraidon

attacks.name: Collision Course
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fighting Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

name: Nidoran♀

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: Females are more sensitive to smells than males. While foraging, they'll use their whiskers to check wind direction and stay downwind of predators.

name: Nidorina

abilities.name: Share Happiness
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

flavorText: The horn on its head has atrophied. It's thought that this happens so Nidorina's children won't get poked while their mother is feeding them.

name: Alolan Meowth

attacks.name: Pay Day
attacks.text: Draw a card.

flavorText: It's accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. As a result, it's very picky about food.

name: Gengar ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Fainting Spell
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, the Attacking Pokémon is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Chaotic Pain
attacks.text: Place 13 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Umbreon

attacks.name: Retaliate
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 100 more damage.

flavorText: The light of the moon changed Eevee's genetic structure. It lurks in the darkness, waiting for prey.

name: Umbreon ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Lunatic Claw
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 140 more damage.

name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Clumsily Clutch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavorText: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

name: Scraggy

attacks.name: Nitpick
attacks.text: Your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.

flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Zorua
flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Zoroark

abilities.name: Nighttime Byway
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, your Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is less.

flavorText: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

name: Deino
flavorText: It nests deep inside a cave. Food there is scarce, so Deino will sink its teeth into anything that moves and attempt to eat it.

name: Zweilous
flavorText: The two heads have different likes and dislikes. Because the heads fight with each other, Zweilous gets stronger without needing to rely on others.

name: Hydreigon

attacks.name: Three-Headed Bite
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: It's said that Hydreigon grew ferocious because people in times long past loathed it, considering it to be evil incarnate and attacking it relentlessly.

name: Yveltal

abilities.name: Life-Locked
abilities.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon can't be healed.

flavorText: It's said that when its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Galarian Meowth

attacks.name: Pay Day
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Treasure Rush
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each card in your hand.

flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

name: Jirachi ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Wish Granter
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Dialga

attacks.name: Reversed Clock
attacks.text: Shuffle up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

flavorText: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.

name: Ferrothorn

attacks.name: Kaboom Needles
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) This Pokémon also does 130 damage to itself.

flavorText: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Solgaleo

abilities.name: Sunrise
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Metal Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Sunsteel Strike
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.

name: Zacian

attacks.name: Hardened Blade
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 40 more damage.

attacks.name: Slashing Strike
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Slashing Strike.

flavorText: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

name: Zamazenta

attacks.name: Fend Off
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Shield Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 50 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

name: Gholdengo

attacks.name: Celebration
attacks.text: If you have exactly 30 cards in your hand, take 2 Prize cards. If you do, shuffle your hand into your deck.

attacks.name: Triple Smash
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

flavorText: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

name: Jangmo-o

attacks.name: Screech
attacks.text: During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes 30 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: They communicate with their allies using the sounds their scales make when struck. A group of these Pokémon causes quite a racket.

name: Hakamo-o
flavorText: It fires itself up by striking its scales with force as it dances. Its roar is a battle cry.

name: Kommo-o
flavorText: It bashes its scales to test its opponents' mettle. The sound of struck Kommo-o scales frightens weaker foes and sends them running.

name: Meowth

attacks.name: Pay Day
attacks.text: Draw a card.

flavorText: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

name: Kangaskhan

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

flavorText: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets its baby out to play only when it feels safe to do so.

name: Ditto

attacks.name: Surprisingly Transform
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon and switch it with this Pokémon. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon. If you switched a Pokémon in this way, put this card into your deck. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life-forms.

name: Eevee

attacks.name: Fetch and Hide
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you put an Item card you find there on the bottom of your opponent's deck.

flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Eevee

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Eevee

name: Snorlax

abilities.name: Good Sleep
abilities.text: If this Pokémon remains Asleep during Pokémon Checkup, heal all damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Collapse
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavorText: Its stomach's digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. Eating things off the ground doesn't bother it at all.

name: Igglybuff

attacks.name: Bouncy Circle
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has a maximum HP of 30.

flavorText: It likes to sing but is not yet good at it. With praise and encouragement, it will get better little by little.

name: Lugia

attacks.name: Elemental Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy, a Water Energy, and a Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

name: Hisuian Zorua
flavorText: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Hisuian Zoroark

attacks.name: Swirling Resentment
attacks.text: Place damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 50.

flavorText: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

name: Minior

attacks.name: Shoot Meteors
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: It feeds on dust in the atmosphere. The color of its core is said to be determined by the composition of the dust it eats.

name: Maushold

attacks.name: Gnaw Together
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Maushold you have in play. For each heads, discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

flavorText: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

name: Poké Pad
rules: Search your deck for a Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

name: Switch
rules: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Ultra Ball
rules: You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand. Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Alolan Exeggutor

abilities.name: Scale Up
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has 6 or more Grass Energy attached, it gets +250 HP.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 50 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

name: Moltres

abilities.name: Fiery Flapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have Articuno and Zapdos in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

name: Lapras

attacks.name: Ferry Across
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

name: Articuno

abilities.name: Frosty Flapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have Moltres and Zapdos in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Water Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hail
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Zapdos

abilities.name: Flash-Pop Flapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have Moltres and Articuno in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thundering Lightning
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.

flavorText: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

name: Toxtricity

attacks.name: Thunderous Bolt
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

flavorText: The jolts of electricity it launches by violently strumming the protrusions on its chest easily exceed 15,000 volts.

name: Morpeko

attacks.name: Select a Snack
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand.

flavorText: It has a small stomach. If it isn't constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.

name: Drifloon

attacks.name: Float Up
attacks.text: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

flavorText: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “signpost for wandering spirits.”

name: Chandelure

attacks.name: Eerie Glow
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.

flavorText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Lycanroc

attacks.name: Counter
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does that much more damage.

flavorText: This Lycanroc has an extremely vicious temperament. It will happily sustain injuries for the sake of taking down its opponent.

name: Alolan Meowth

attacks.name: Pay Day
attacks.text: Draw a card.

flavorText: It's accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. As a result, it's very picky about food.

name: Scraggy

attacks.name: Nitpick
attacks.text: Your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.

flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Galarian Meowth

attacks.name: Pay Day
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Treasure Rush
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each card in your hand.

flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.
